Renderings: the creation and Eden companions (project glossary)

Binding for the seven texts of this project, on top of the corpus renderings (../renderings.md), which inherit the flood corpus's (../../סיפורי-המבול-המסופוטמיים/renderings.md), and the Sumerian conventions of flood project 3 (../../סיפורי-המבול-המסופוטמיים/3-סיפור-המבול-השומרי--זיוסודרה/renderings.md).
Echo tags: guidelines §6.4. Section 1–3 were fixed by the coordinator before drafting (2026-10-16); translators add rows in §4 (one sub-table per text) and propose changes in project.md.

1. Names (first occurrence vocalized in each text)

Original Hebrew Notes
Adapa אֲדָפָּה (corpus note). First occurrence: the sage of Eridu; in later tradition the first of the seven apkallū (the Uruk list: U-An / Uanadapa).
Ea / Enki אֵאָה / אֶנְקִי Keep the name the text uses: Akkadian texts אֵאָה, Sumerian texts אֶנְקִי. In a bilingual line the Akkadian name stands in the Hebrew, the Sumerian in the apparatus.
Anu / An אָנוּ / אַן Akkadian / Sumerian.
Enlil / Ellil אֶנְלִיל
Ninḫursaĝa נִין־חֻרְסַגָּה Shared (flood corpus).
Nintu (Akk.) / Nintur (Sum.) נִינְתּוּ / נִינְתּוּר Shared.
Ninmaḫ נִינְמַח Corpus note. "Exalted lady".
Aruru אֲרוּרוּ Shared. Note at first occurrence: no relation to אָרוּר (the sound only).
Namma נַמָּה Enki's mother, the primeval water (Enki and Ninmaḫ).
Anuna / Anunnakkū אֲנוּנָּה / אֲנוּנָּכִּי Sumerian / Akkadian.
Igigū אִיגִיגִי
Utu / Šamaš אוּתוּ / שַׁמַשׁ Shared. Utu is always vocalized (אוּתוּ, unvocalized it reads "him").
Dilmun דִּלְמוּן Shared.
Eridu (Eridug) אֶרִידוּ Shared.
Abzu / Apsû הָאַפְּסוּ Shared (the place). In a Sumerian text the apparatus gives abzu.
Engur הָאֶנְגּוּר The subterranean water, = Abzu; first occurrence note. Not תְּהוֹם.
Tigris / Euphrates (Sum. idigna, buranun; Akk. Idiqlat, Purattu) חִדֶּקֶל / פְּרָת Shared [cognate] (בראשית ב:יד).
Marduk; Asalluḫi מַרְדּוּךְ; אֲסַלּוּחִי Corpus (project 1 open decision 6 on אֲסַרְלוּחִי: in a Sumerian text the form is Asalluḫi, so אֲסַלּוּחִי).
Nippur; Ekur; Uruk; Eanna; Babylon; Esagil נִיפּוּר; אֵכּוּר; אוּרוּךְ; אֵאַנָּה; בָּבֶל; אֵסַגִּיל Shared / corpus. Uruk first-occurrence note: = אֶרֶךְ (בראשית י:י).

2. Cross-text terms (Akkadian and Sumerian), fixed before drafting

Original Hebrew Tag Notes
akalu; Sum. ninda לֶחֶם [cognate] (Akk.) ↔ בְּזֵעַת אַפֶּיךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם (ג:יט). akal mūti / akal balāṭi = לֶחֶם הַמָּוֶת / לֶחֶם הַחַיִּים.
mû; mê mūti / mê balāṭi מַיִם; מֵי הַמָּוֶת / מֵי הַחַיִּים [cognate]
akālu; Sum. gu₇ אָכַל [cognate] (Akk.) ↔ ב:טז–יז; ג:ו.
šatû; Sum. naĝ שָׁתָה [cognate] (Akk.)
mūtu; mâtu מָוֶת; מֵת [cognate] ↔ מוֹת תָּמוּת (ב:יז); לֹא מוֹת תְּמֻתוּן (ג:ד).
balāṭu (noun); balāṭu G; D bulluṭu; Sum. zi, ti/til₃ חַיִּים; חַי, חָיָה; הֶחֱיָה (shared); חַיִּים / חַי [equivalent] ↔ וָחַי לְעֹלָם (ג:כב). Not cognate (the Akkadian root is blṭ).
napištu dārītu, balāṭ dārâti; Sum. zi da-ri₂ חַיֵּי נֶצַח [equivalent] / [divergence] Shared with flood project 3 (Ziusudra's "life like a god"). Not חַיֵּי עוֹלָם, which would pre-empt לְעֹלָם (ג:כב).
nēmequ; uznu (as "understanding"); ḫasīsu חָכְמָה; בִּינָה (with a note "lit. 'ear'"); תְּבוּנָה (shared) Keep the three apart. ↔ עֵץ הַדַּעַת (ב:ט) [divergence]: none of them is דַּעַת. idû "know" = יָדַע [cognate].
apkallu; Sum. abgal חָכָם Shared (not נְפִילִים).
labāšu G "to put on, wear"; Š "to clothe"; Sum. mu₄ לָבַשׁ; הִלְבִּישׁ [cognate] (Akk.) ↔ וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם (ג:כא).
lubāru, lubuštu; Sum. tug₂ בֶּגֶד (lubāru, tug₂); לְבוּשׁ (lubuštu) [equivalent] / [cognate] (lubuštu ~ לבוש) ↔ כָּתְנוֹת עוֹר (ג:כא) [divergence]. Never כֻּתֹּנֶת (Akk. kitû "linen" is its cognate, if it occurs).
šamnu; pašāšu שֶׁמֶן; סָךְ [cognate] / [equivalent]
ṣiāḫu צָחַק [cognate] Flood corpus (Gilg. XI 165).
eperu; ṭiṭṭu / ṭīdu; Sum. saḫar; im עָפָר; טִיט [cognate] (eperu) / [cognate] (ṭiṭṭu) ↔ עָפָר מִן הָאֲדָמָה (ב:ז); עָפָר אַתָּה (ג:יט). Sum. im "clay" = טִיט; saḫar "dust, earth" = עָפָר.
ṣēru; Sum. edin עֲרָבָה [equivalent] ↔ שִׂיחַ הַשָּׂדֶה (ב:ה) Shared (never עֵדֶן / שָׂדֶה); the edin/עדן etymology in the apparatus only.
eqlu; Sum. a-šag₄ שָׂדֶה [equivalent] The cultivated field. So that שָׂדֶה stays the field and עֲרָבָה the steppe.
erṣetu; mātu; Sum. ki, kalam אֶרֶץ; אֶרֶץ; ki: מָקוֹם / אֶרֶץ (with an) / אֲדָמָה only for tilled or irrigated ground (with a note); kalam: הָאָרֶץ Shared (flood project 3). The אָדָם/אֲדָמָה pun is Hebrew only: never manufacture it.
Sum. an ki; an ki bad / an ki-ta bad; Akk. šamû u erṣetu; parāsu שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ; הִפְרִיד אֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם מִן הָאָרֶץ [equivalent] ↔ וַיַּבְדֵּל (א:ז) Never הִבְדִּיל (corpus §3): Sumerian bad "open, be distant, separate" = הִפְרִיד / הִרְחִיק by context, noted.
Sum. dim₂; Akk. banû, patāqu, eṣēru עִצֵּב (dim₂); בָּנָה; עִצֵּב (patāqu); צָר [equivalent] / [cognate] Shared: יָצַר / בָּרָא are never used. Sum. du₃ "build" = בָּנָה; tud "give birth, beget" = יָלַד.
Sum. mu₂ "to grow, sprout"; Akk. (w)aṣû "come forth" צָמַח, הִצְמִיחַ; יָצָא, הוֹצִיא [equivalent] / [cognate] ↔ וַיַּצְמַח (ב:ט); תּוֹצֵא הָאָרֶץ (א:כד). Choose by meaning; tag every occurrence.
Sum. u₂; Akk. šammu צֶמַח (a plant, a herb; the eight plants); עֵשֶׂב (grass, grazing) [equivalent] ↔ עֵשֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶה (ב:ה; ג:יח). The annotated file says which sense.
Sum. ĝiš; Akk. iṣu; Sum. gi, Akk. qanû עֵץ; קָנֶה [cognate] (iṣu, qanû)
Sum. {ĝiš}kiri₆; Akk. kirû גַּן (orchard) [equivalent] ↔ גַּן בְּעֵדֶן (ב:ח) Choose by meaning: kiri₆ is a garden/orchard. Tag every occurrence.
zēru; Sum. numun זֶרַע [equivalent] Shared.
nišū; awīlūtu; amēlu; lullû; Sum. uĝ₃, nam-lu₂-ulu₃, lu₂, lu₂-ulu₃ (Akk. lullû) הָאֲנָשִׁים; הָאֱנוֹשׁוּת; אָדָם; קַדְמוֹן; uĝ₃ הָאֲנָשִׁים, nam-lu₂-ulu₃ הָאֱנוֹשׁוּת, lu₂ אִישׁ / אָדָם (by context), lu₂-ulu₃ קַדְמוֹן Shared. Sum. saĝ gig₂(-ga) / Akk. ṣalmāt qaqqadi = שְׁחוֹרֵי הָרֹאשׁ.
dullu; šupšikku; kudurru; Sum. kin, dulum; dub-sig, {ĝiš}dusu עָמָל; סַל; kin עֲבוֹדָה (with a note), dulum עָמָל; dub-sig / dusu סַל [divergence] ↔ לְעָבְדָהּ וּלְשָׁמְרָהּ (ב:טו) Shared: the gods' toil laid on man. עָבַד only where the original is a verb "to work, serve" (with a tag).
Sum. nam tar; Akk. šīmta šâmu גָּזַר גּוֹרָל; גּוֹרָלוֹ נִגְזַר Shared. nam "fate" = גּוֹרָל.
Sum. mu sa₄; Akk. nabû, šuma nabû קָרָא שֵׁם / קָרָא בְּשֵׁם [equivalent] ↔ ב:יט–כ; ג:כ Corpus: קָרָא is reserved for naming. Sum. gu₃ de₂ "to call out, address" = פָּנָה אֶל … (וְאָמַר) / צָעַק by context, never קָרָא. Akk. šasû = צָעַק.
Sum. inim dug₄; inim; Akk. amātu אָמַר דָּבָר; דָּבָר Shared.
Sum. ud-ba; Akk. ina ūmīšu; Sum. ud re-a, ud ul-li₂-a בָּעֵת הַהִיא; בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם (only where the original has "days") [equivalent] ↔ ו:ד Shared.
pān mê פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם [cognate] ↔ עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם (א:ב)
tâmtu; Sum. a-ab-ba יָם Shared (cognate of תְּהוֹם in the apparatus only).
nammaššû; būl Šakkan הַנָּע; חַיַּת שַׁכַּן Shared (הַנָּע, never רֶמֶשׂ). būlu "(wild) animals, herds" = חַיָּה with a note.
urqītu יֶרֶק [cognate] Corpus (↔ יֶרֶק עֵשֶׂב, א:ל).
arāru; erretu; Sum. aš bal, nam-erim₂ אָרַר; אָרָה, מְאֵרָה; aš bal קִלֵּל (with a note) [cognate] (arāru) ↔ אָרוּר (ג:יד, יז). Only arāru is אָרַר.
Sum. ti "rib"; ti, til₃ "life, live" צֵלָע; חַיִּים [cognate?] (none) / [equivalent] The Nin-ti pun: the name is transliterated נִין־תִּי and both senses are given in the note; ↔ ב:כא–כב, ג:כ (debated).
muš; Akk. ṣerru, mušḫuššu נָחָשׁ (muš, ṣerru "snake") [equivalent] ↔ ג:א By meaning; tag every occurrence.
Sum. ur-mah; ur-bar-ra; ur-gir₁₅; Akk. nēšu אַרְיֵה; זְאֵב; כֶּלֶב; אַרְיֵה ↔ ישעיהו יא:ו–ט [equivalent].
Sum. ki-sikil; nu-gig; munus עַלְמָה; הַגְּבִירָה (shared); אִשָּׁה
ālittu / lā ālittu; Sum. munus nu-u₃-tu יוֹלֶדֶת / לֹא יוֹלֶדֶת [equivalent] ↔ עֲקָרָה (יא:ל) Shared: not עֲקָרָה in the text.
Sum. gu₄; u₈; udu; sila₄; maš₂; ud₅ שׁוֹר; כִּבְשָׂה; צֹאן / כֶּבֶשׂ; טָלֶה; גְּדִי; עֵז
Sum. ezina₂ / ašnan (personified Grain); u₈ / laḫar (personified Sheep) דָּגָן; כִּבְשָׂה Corpus (EE III 9 ašnan = דָּגָן). The names of the goddesses (Ezina-Kusu, Lahar) in the note.

3. Reserved words (not used in the Hebrew of any text unless the original word is their cognate or exact meaning, and then tagged)

עֵדֶן, בָּרָא, יָצַר, הִבְדִּיל, רָקִיעַ, תְּהוֹם, תַּנִּין, צֶלֶם, דְּמוּת, נָפַח / נִשְׁמַת חַיִּים (Akk. napāḫu "to blow" is a cognate: then tag it), עֵץ הַחַיִּים / עֵץ הַדַּעַת (only if the original says "tree of life / knowledge"), עָרוּם / עֵירֹם (only for a word meaning "naked"; tag), כְּתֹנֶת, תַּרְדֵּמָה, עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ, אֵד (only for edû), לְעָבְדָהּ וּלְשָׁמְרָהּ, מְלָאכָה (project 1 open decision 4: šipru = פֹּעַל in the creation corpus), שָׁבַת, צָבָא, רֶמֶשׂ, שֶׁרֶץ, נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה, חַוָּה, כְּרוּבִים, לַהַט הַחֶרֶב, קֶדֶם (as "east": use מִזְרָח).

Text 1: Adapa

Original Hebrew Tag Notes Lines
Ilabrat (Ili-abrat), Anu's šukkallu אִילַבְּרַת; šukkallu = וְזִיר šukkallu as in Enūma eliš (Foster: "courier"). MB 8', 10'
Dumuzi דּוּמוּזִי [cognate] (name) ↔ תַּמּוּז (יחזקאל ח:יד) Note only; never תַּמּוּז in the text (deities are not assimilated). MB 21', 28', 44', 51', 62'; SB c+18, d+9
Gizzida (eBL lemma Ningišzida) גִּיזִּידָה (note: נִינְגִּשְׁזִידָה) The text's own short form. MB 21', 28', 44', 51', 62'; SB c+18, d+9
Ninkarrak נִינְכַּרַּךְ Healing goddess (= Gula; Sum. Nin-Isina). SB e+17
Anunnakkū אֲנוּנָּכִּי Shared. SB a+8
šūtu (the South Wind, an acting figure) רוּחַ הַדָּרוֹם [absent] ↔ לְרוּחַ הַיּוֹם (ג:ח) One Akkadian word; רוּחַ is Hebrew idiom, not šāru. In a list of directions דָּרוֹם (Enūma eliš IV 43). Feminine. MB 2'–11', 40', 55', 59'; SB b+5–13, e+13, e+15, e+18, f+3, f+6
ša šūti kappaša / kappi šūti כְּנָפָהּ שֶׁל רוּחַ הַדָּרוֹם / כְּנַף רוּחַ הַדָּרוֹם Anticipatory genitive vs construct. kappu = כָּנָף. MB 6', 11', 40', 55'; SB e+13
šebēru G / N שָׁבַר / נִשְׁבַּר [cognate] MB 5', 6', 11', 40', 55'; SB e+13
nazāru גִּדֵּף [divergence] ↔ אָרוּר (ג:יד) Not אָרַר (= arāru), not קִלֵּל (= Sum. aš bal). MB 61'
akala ša mūti / akal balāṭi; mê mūti / mê balāṭi לֶחֶם הַמָּוֶת / לֶחֶם הַחַיִּים; מֵי הַמָּוֶת / מֵי הַחַיִּים [cognate] (akalu, mû, mūtu) / [equivalent] (balāṭu) §2 applied; ša-genitive and construct both rendered by the Hebrew construct. MB 33'–34', 68'–70'; SB e+1
lā takkal, lā tašatti (lā + present) לֹא תֹאכַל, לֹא תִשְׁתֶּה [cognate] ↔ לֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ (ב:יז) The apodictic prohibition. MB 33'–34', 76'
kullu D (ukallūnikkum) הוֹשִׁיט "Hold out, proffer". MB 33'–36'
leqû (+ ventive + dat.) לָקַח (לוֹ) [cognate] ↔ וְלָקַח (ג:כב), לֻקָּחְתָּ (ג:יט) Every occurrence לקח. MB 14', 68'–72', 77'
târu (D?) הֵשִׁיב [cognate] ↔ עַד שׁוּבְךָ (ג:יט) שוב reserved for târu; saḫāru = חָזַר. Partly restored. MB 77'
qaqqaru קַרְקַע [equivalent] ↔ אֲדָמָה (ג:יט) Not אֲדָמָה (echo control; no אָדָם/אֲדָמָה pun). MB 77'
lubāru / ṣubātu / karru בֶּגֶד / שִׂמְלָה / מַעֲטֵה אֵבֶל [divergence] ↔ כָּתְנוֹת עוֹר (ג:כא) karru not שַׂק (saqqu), not בִּגְדֵי אֵבֶל (בגד = lubāru). MB 17', 24', 35', 47', 49', 71'; SB c+13, e+3
labāšu G stat. / Gt / N; Š לָבוּשׁ, לָבַשׁ; הִלְבִּישׁ [cognate] ↔ וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם (ג:כא) Š only MB 17' (restored). MB 17', 24', 35', 47', 49', 71'; SB e+3

Changelog

  • 2026-10-16: §1–3 written by the coordinator before drafting text 1, from the corpus renderings, the flood corpus's shared renderings and Sumerian project 3.
  • 2026-10-16: §4 "Text 1: Adapa" added by the text-1 translator. §1–3 unchanged and followed (akalu, mû, mūtu, balāṭu, napištu dārītu, nēmequ/uznu/ḫasīsu, labāšu, lubāru, šamnu/pašāšu, ṣiāḫu, apkallu, nišū, awīlūtu, banû, zēru, šasû as fixed). One usage differs from project 1's glossary (not from these sections): ṭeḫû = נִגַּשׁ, because its cognate-bearing synonym qerēbu = קָרַב occurs in the same text (project.md, Text 1, Decision 8).
  • 2026-10-16/17: §4 "Text 2: Enki and Ninḫursaĝa" added by the text-2 translator. §1–3 followed; three usages differ by meaning and are explained in project.md, Text 2, Decisions 9: Sum. ki "earth (from below)" = הָאָרֶץ without an (43, 54); zi as the body part "throat" = נֶפֶשׁ (264); du₃ of trees = נָטַע? (227). The §2 row aš bal, nam-erim₂ is specified (not changed): nam-erim₂ kud = נִשְׁבַּע שְׁבוּעָה.
  • 2026-10-17: §4 "Text 3: Enki and Ninmaḫ" added by the text-3 translator. §1–3 followed (im = טִיט, dim₂ = עִצֵּב, nam tar, mu sa₄ = קָרָא שֵׁם, munus nu-u₃-tud = לֹא יוֹלֶדֶת, sag₉ = נָאֶה, kin/dulum/dub-sig, edin not in the text). Deviations by meaning (project.md, Text 3, Decision 14): inim ĝar = דָּבָר שָׂם (11); zi as dying breath = נֶפֶשׁ (89, as text 2); tuku by sense. New reserved use: שָׂם only for ĝar (Decision 5).
  • 2026-10-17: §4 "Text 4: The Song of the Hoe" added by the text-4 translator. §1–3 and the earlier rows followed (an ki-ta bad = הִפְרִיד … מִן, ĝar = שָׂם only, nam tar, dim₂ not in the text, mu₂ = צָמַח, e₃ = יָצָא, ki = הָאָרֶץ (never אֲדָמָה), kalam = הָאָרֶץ, numun = זֶרַע, dusu = סַל, saĝ gig₂ = שְׁחוֹרֵי הָרֹאשׁ, sa₄ = קָרָא, za₃-mi₂ = תְּהִילָּה, igi bar = הִבִּיט, sukkal = וְזִיר, ušumgal = דְּרָקוֹן־עֲנָק). Deviations by meaning (project.md, Text 4, Decisions): du₃ = קָבַע (9) and נָעַץ (18); lugal of a field = בְּעָלִים (101–103); ĝal₂ with an agent placing an object = נָתַן (17). Not changed, flagged: numun₂ = חַלְפָה here vs text 3 (43) אַסְפֶּסֶת?; text 2 (281) תהלה vs texts 3–4 תהילה.

  • 2026-10-17: §4 "Text 5: Grain and Sheep" added by the text-5 translator. §1–3 and the earlier rows followed (ninda לחם, gu₇ אכל, naĝ שתה, tug₂ בגד, mu₄ לבש, u₂ עשב, ezina₂ דגן, u₈ כבשה, ud re-a בימים ההם, ud-ba בעת ההיא, nam-lu₂-ulu₃ האנושות, ĝar = שָׂם only, gu₃ de₂ / gi₄-gi₄ formulas, nam tar, dim₂ עיצב, tud ילד, mu₂ צמח, e₃ יצא, ki/kalam הארץ (never אדמה), edin ערבה, sag₉/dug₃, men כתר, si sa₂ סידר, saĝ šum₂ מיהר, sa₂-dug₄ המנחות הקבועות, spelling שמים, תהילה). numun₂ does not occur. Deviations by meaning (project.md, Text 5, Decision 12): sig₉ = תקע (5; elsewhere הטיל); sig₇ = הוריק? / רעננה; zig₃ (adj.) = זקוף; lipiš (figurative) = קרב; du₈ by sense; tag = נעץ (131); ĝeštin = יין (the drink); bar-rim₄ = צייה (text 2 היבשה in another sense).
